entities.name: Parking Reduction
entities.description: A policy or measure aimed at reducing parking requirements or availability near transit stops or within certain distances to promote alternative transportation and reduce congestion.

entities.name: Major Transit Stop
entities.description: A significant public transportation point such as a metro station or intersection of major bus or trolley routes with high-frequency service, typically within a half-mile radius.

entities.name: Accessibility
entities.description: The ease of reaching and using transit stops or facilities, including accessible routes from properties within a quarter mile of transit stops.

entities.name: Trolley Stops
entities.description: Stops along trolley routes that are part of the city's public transit network, often included in high-frequency transit corridors.

entities.name: Bus Stops
entities.description: Designated locations where buses pick up and drop off passengers, especially those on high-frequency routes during peak hours.
